content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Packaged protein shakes and bars sold through grocery retail; no connected fitness hardware or streaming subscription."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"B2B payment and telemetry systems for vending and unattended retail operators, not home fitness equipment sold to consumers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Crafting machines and materials for hobbyists; shares connected hardware and subscription model but serves a different consumer activity."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Footwear and apparel brands sold wholesale and through stores; no equipment, classes or streaming."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Apparel and accessories designed and licensed for department and off-price retailers; no fitness equipment or subscriptions."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"B2B online marketplace reselling bulk furniture and home goods; a wholesale distribution business, not direct-to-consumer fitness."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Digital publishing monetized by advertising and affiliate commissions; no equipment sales or paid workout classes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Franchised gym memberships with physical clubs and royalties; a different service model from connected home fitness hardware and streaming."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Televised and online retail of third-party consumer goods; a merchandise retailer, not fitness equipment or content."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Branded snacks and shakes outsourced to contract makers; packaged food rather than fitness hardware or class subscriptions."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Home furnishings and kitchenware retailer with stores and design services; no connected products or fitness subscriptions."}]}
